evidence_artifacts.description: Master machine-readable canonical registry for all 12 benchmark families, tracking population, seeds, metrics, and mandatory caveats.
Authoritative tabular summary of empirical benchmark results, deltas, and sample standard deviations.
Comprehensive provenance guide detailing one-way evidence flow, dataset taxonomy, and retired evidence inventory.
Formal negative results ledger (NR-001 to NR-005), anti-metric shopping protocol, and epistemic vulnerability matrix.
Authoritative evaluation of compound transaction lifecycle failure, cross-tenant composition, provenance races, and 7-dimension semantic reconciliation.
Evaluation of multi-worker CAS, ambiguous commits, client retry, model round recovery, and worker restart invariants.
Initial whole-system verification report establishing foundation cross-domain invariants and fail-closed model inference repair.
Executable test suite covering 5 primary adversarial lifecycle scenarios, 7 final invariants, and 3 metamorphic checks.
Executable test suite covering distributed coordination, ambiguous commits, worker restart, and security fail-closed behavior.
Executable integration suite covering case CAS, decision provenance, active privacy, and human vs machine outcome separation.
Executable end-to-end suite verifying multi-tenant isolation, same-ID coexistence, and BOLA prevention.
Executable suite verifying streaming redelivery metamorphic equivalence, parallel transaction preservation, and crash-window idempotency.
Level 1 canonical raw benchmark results on 590,540 real Kaggle IEEE-CIS transactions (Centralized AP: 0.4422, FedAvg AP: 0.3895).
Level 1 canonical raw benchmark on European Credit Card dataset with budget-equalized execution (Centralized AP: 0.8219, FedAvg AP: 0.8248).
Level 1 canonical raw benchmark on Elliptic Bitcoin graph (203k nodes, 234k edges) under Inductive GraphSAGE (AP: 0.3761).
72-condition canonical multi-round federated benchmark on real Credit Card data under scaled sign-inversion attacks across 12 simulated bank clients.
Flagship CrossBank v2 synthetic multi-bank benchmark across 5 seeds and 7 topologies under Protocol 2.1.0.

Quarantined single-seed algebraic prototype claiming 99.7% universal retention; retained strictly for historical audit provenance.
Retired 1,500-node synthetic chain graph benchmark (0.9001 / 0.9860), permanently superseded by canonical Elliptic real-data benchmark.
Historical synthetic fallback run (0.7811 / 0.7554), permanently superseded by canonical Kaggle 590k raw dataset execution.
Local in-memory fallback store simulating Redis key-value storage; physical multi-node Redis cluster failover not exercised.
Software-emulated TEE driver; bare-metal hardware SGX/Nitro attestation requires physical cloud enclaves.
Interactive demonstration landing surface for platform overview and visual onboarding; showcase only.
Live operations dashboard for real-time transaction streaming, alert feed, and simulation monitoring.
